decisions.reason: Actually compared exact source and returned raw-master white/cyan/alpha views on page8. The original has a visible mild smiling expression, lifted mouth corners and its own less-angry eyebrow angle. The return gives it a pronounced angry scowl with strongly downturned brows and a closed stern mouth. Restore only the actual source smile/mouth corners, brow direction and head/gaze angle without exaggerating a grin or frown. Do not invent facial hair. Keep all unrelated actual receding short hair, smooth face, brown coat, pale shirt/blue tie, source illumination/crop, compact broad short collar fit and opaque photo/card backing with actual exterior alpha.
